english.note: Use 爺爺 as the all-purpose everyday term for a paternal grandfather.
This is the all-purpose everyday family term for a grandfather, especially a paternal grandfather.
This is the usual word for a paternal grandfather and the best everyday choice when the family side is clear or unspecified.

examples.english: My grandfather often takes me for dim sum.
examples.traditional: 我爺爺成日帶我去飲茶。
